svg.title: One next-character prediction in a causal Transformer
svg.desc: A forward-pass diagram showing how the context T, h, e and space is converted into embeddings, processed with causal self-attention, transformed by residual and feed-forward operations, and used to predict a probability distribution for the next character after the sequence The space.

text.tspan: Forward pass for the context "F i r s", with model width d = 48 and vocabulary size V = 65.
